findings.reason: the node is dispatched to make this test fail on main under a wall-clock move, and no move can, so its declared negative control is unrealizable and the node's whole measure rests on a drift that is not there.
findings.text: §31's done-when asserts the test "fails on main under that move" and names the drifting assertion as the figure comparison `approx(..., rel=0.01)`, but that assertion is view-sourced and does not move: I copied `tests/test_picker_dispatch_pace.py` to a scratch tree, injected `_freeze_snapshot_clock(monkeypatch, now + delta)` (the same single-clock mechanism §27 used) after the test's `now = datetime.now(UTC)` at line 251, and ran `test_dispatch_uses_published_window_as_direct_pick_does` at delta = +1h, +3h, +2d and +30d — it passed every time (4/4). The test samples `datetime.now(UTC)` once in its own body (line 251); every other use is that same `now`, and the only wall-clock-derived assertion (the `budget_age_s == approx(0, abs=1)` at line 292) is fed `moment=now`, so it is pinned to the reading's own observation and cannot drift either.

findings.reason: the node building §30 must decide what `estimated_tokens` becomes and whether the block documents two figures; left unstated it will ship a self-contradictory block, which is the opposite of the "one rule for both" §15 established.
findings.text: §30 says to compute the block's `headroom_pct` from the estimate the gate used (`_context_fit_verdict`'s `estimated_tokens` = standing chain + files, routing.py:3589), while the same block keeps `estimated_tokens = node_tokens` (the harness-independent figure, snapshot.py:234,809). For any candidate whose lane carries a standing chain, `headroom_pct` will no longer equal `100*(window_tokens - estimated_tokens)/window_tokens`, so the block presents two token figures Jev cannot reconcile, and §15's invariant (the block's `estimated_tokens` equals the request estimate) forbids fixing it by swapping `estimated_tokens` to the gate's figure. The plan names neither which figure the block's `estimated_tokens` should carry after the change nor that the two figures are meant to differ.
